items.subject: HOMS Marking Relief Request - EDU221 Essay Batch
items.recommended_action: Route to HOMS marking relief pilot and request fake or redacted sample batch.
items.next_step: Prepare HOMS marking request for batch, rubric, memo, marksheet, and lecturer review summary.
items.body: I have a marking backlog and want a HOMS marking relief pilot. The batch includes essay submissions, a rubric, a memo, and a marksheet. I need draft feedback, rubric mapping, marks CSV support, and a lecturer review summary. The sample can be fake or redacted; I will approve final marks and feedback.
